description: Finish an accepted DRAFT (a lab_reference_motion run with draft: true) in 1080p — same motion, same seed, same sound, sharper picture. A NEW video row comes back; the draft stays. Works only while the draft is valid and only through the account that ordered it; otherwise the backend refuses with a named reason (entwurf_abgelaufen, entwurf_anderes_konto, entwurf_fehlt, bereits_fertiggestellt) before anything is charged. Never download and re-upload a draft to get here: that is a new run, not this draft. Costs credits when called without get_cost.

get_cost.description: Preflight: return the price in credits and the draft's expiry WITHOUT finishing it and without spending anything. Do this first and let the human confirm.
